WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        f.DateKey,
        d.IsHoliday,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS day_total
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
    JOIN retail.DimDate d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    GROUP BY f.DateKey, d.IsHoliday
),
avg_by_type AS (
    SELECT
        IsHoliday,
        avg(day_total) AS avg_daily_sales
    FROM daily_sales
    GROUP BY IsHoliday
)
SELECT
    sumIf(avg_daily_sales, IsHoliday = 'Yes')  AS avg_holiday_sales,
    sumIf(avg_daily_sales, IsHoliday = 'No')   AS avg_regular_sales,
    (
        sumIf(avg_daily_sales, IsHoliday = 'Yes')
        - sumIf(avg_daily_sales, IsHoliday = 'No')
    ) * 100.0
    / nullif(sumIf(avg_daily_sales, IsHoliday = 'No'), 0) AS holiday_vs_regular_pct_diff
FROM avg_by_type
